title: The build's markdown loops for ever (and runs out of memory) on a line that starts with "|" and is not followed by…
summary: incident.conductor@: the build's markdown loops for ever (and runs out of memory) on a line that starts with "|" and is not followed by a table rule: admin/build/build.mjs, the paragraph loop. My generator now refuses to write such a line; the build would be safer with i++ there.
closes: The one it waits on answers, and the asking agent's status file no longer lists it.
